datacube_abstraction.name: Apple Datacube Memory Container
datacube_abstraction.purpose: Hardware-fenced physical page container donated from Darwin/XNU to ExclaveOS without compromise of spatial isolation.

state_machine.description: Physical page allocated in host RAM pool (e.g. kalloc, IOGPU, or AppleJPEG driver).
XNU unmaps page from host Stage-1 translation table and invokes _exclaves_ctl_trap to donate physical range.
Apple Silicon Secure Page Table Monitor locks Stage-2 physical page attributes; notifies PMM via IPC notification.
PMM invokes L4_Untyped_Create, converting physical range into L4_Type_Arm64_FrameLevel0 (16 KB) capability.
VASCore maps frame capability into Conclave virtual address space via _map_this_frame.
Upon Conclave unmap or termination, frame is scrubbed with zero-fill and released back to XNU via xnu_frame_unreserve.

error_handling.retype_failure_assertion: [PMM] failed to retype xnu page via Release Datacube. paddr %#llx, error %s(%zu)
error_handling.return_to_xnu_error: error return pages to XNU, xnu_error 0x%x

spm_fencing.mechanism: Apple Silicon Secure Page Manager (SPTM / SPM)
spm_fencing.guarantee: Once a physical page transitions into RETYPED_FRAME, the host XNU kernel is physically blocked by hardware Stage-2 translation fault from reading or writing page bytes.

pmm_server.role: Physical Memory Manager & Datacube Retyping Server

xnu_allocator.name: XNU Donated Memory Allocator
xnu_allocator.description: Receives external physical memory frames donated dynamically by Darwin host kernel.

memory_tagging_extension.description: Hardened conclaves allocate MTE-tagged physical pages where upper 4 bits of physical address enforce hardware memory safety.

untyped_memory_matrix.address_bounds_check: [PMM] raw_frame_create paddr %#llx too small (< %llx), error paddr too big %#llx (> %llx)
